components.css: .ds-board { background:#2747c9; padding:40px; } .ds-flyer { position:relative; max-width:300px; padding:24px; background:#fff27a; color:#17181c; border-radius:2px; transform:rotate(-1.5deg); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgb(10 18 60 / 0.10), 0 10px 18px -10px rgb(8 16 58 / 0.55); transition:transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); font-family:Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-flyer:hover, .ds-flyer:focus-visible { transform:rotate(0) translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgb(10 18 60 / 0.08), 0 26px 34px -18px rgb(8 16 58 / 0.65); outline:none; } .ds-flyer h3 { font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.2rem; margin:12px 0 6px; } .ds-flyer p { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:0.9rem; color:#3f424b; } .ds-flyer em { font-family:Kalam,cursive; font-style:normal; color:#3f424b; } .ds-pin { position:absolute; top:-10px; left:50%; width:18px; height:18px; margin-left:-9px; border-radius:50%; background:#e23b2e; box-shadow:2px 3px 3px rgb(8 16 58 / 0.3); } .ds-stamp { display:inline-block; border:1.5px solid #17181c; border-radius:9999px; padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Truss looks like the notice board outside a college placement cell: a saturated blue soft-board, and on it paper flyers pinned up by people you know. Every piece of content is a sheet of paper. The board is loud and the paper is quiet, so the eye always lands on the posts.
keyCharacteristics: A blue board as the page background, with paper sheets as the only content surfaces.
Sheets are tilted by small, varied angles and straighten on hover or focus.
Pins and tape show how a sheet is attached.
A chunky grotesque display face, a plain humanist sans for body text, and a handwritten face only for tags.
Yellow highlighter and yellow paper carry emphasis and the main action.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Ink-colored text only ever sits on paper. Text on the board is Board White or Board Mist.

rules.name: The One Yellow Thing Rule
rules.body: Each viewport has one primary yellow action.

rules.name: The Handwriting Is Annotation Rule
rules.body: Kalam is never used for headings, buttons, form labels, or anything a student must read to complete a task.

rules.name: The Straighten-Up Rule
rules.body: Interactive sheets rotate back to 0deg and lift on hover or focus. With reduced motion, tilt stays but movement is removed.

dos: Do put every piece of content on a sheet of paper, and keep the board itself empty.
Do vary tilts slightly between neighboring sheets (between -2° and +2°), and keep forms and long reading sheets at or below 1°.
Do label all illustrative posts and people with a handwritten "Example" tag.
Do use the highlighter on two to four words of a headline, not whole sentences.
Do keep primary text contrast at WCAG AA or better on every paper color, in both themes.
donts: Don't add rounded "SaaS cards", glassmorphism, or gradient backgrounds. Surfaces are paper on a board.
Don't fabricate stats, testimonials, or counts.
Don't use Kalam for headings, buttons, or form labels.
Don't use more than one yellow primary button per viewport.
Don't reintroduce the removed Dashboard or Truss Connect surfaces.
